selected_variables: control_optimization knot inputs over the 0.6 s horizon

input.expected_observation: The returned finite MuJoCo search reports a valid best schedule and modeled rollout with lower objective and terminal error than its starting source, with terminal_error_m trending toward 0.01 m and holding_max_speed_m_s trending toward 0.03 m/s.
input.fixed_conditions: Keep candidate artifact, frozen reach target [0.295, 0, 0.215] m, 0.6 s duration, 0.02 s control period, model configuration, geometry, routing, topology, and evaluator fixed. Optimize only the bounded control schedule using local_control_search_v2, four knots at [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6] s, and a 0.06 s correction window; at most 24 callbacks and 3 iterations.
input.hypothesis: For the frozen Operator-generated structure, bounded nonlinear control optimization with four knots and a terminal correction window can find an input schedule whose modeled terminal tip error is substantially below the unoptimized baseline while also reducing final-window speed; this is a finite-search capability hypothesis, not a claim of task acceptance or global optimality.
input.interpretation: Improvement would support only local modeled control capability for this exact candidate and search budget. Failure would indicate weakness of this source/search configuration, not structural infeasibility.
input.stopping_condition: Stop this analysis after one admitted finite nonlinear capability result, or earlier on numerical or admission failure; do not infer physical performance, infeasibility, or a global optimum.
input.weakening_observation: No valid schedule is produced, numerical failure occurs, or the best finite-search rollout fails to improve terminal error and final-window speed over its starting source.

Optimize only the legal control source using local_control_search_v2, no more than four knots, no more than three iterations, and no more than 24 callbacks; use a final correction window consistent with the 0.06 s holding window.
input.hypothesis: For the frozen reach-and-hold task, bounded nonlinear control optimization of the owned Operator-generated structure can find a four-knot control schedule whose simulated terminal error, final-window maximum position error, and final-window maximum tip speed satisfy the task thresholds.
input.interpretation: A threshold-satisfying valid model rollout would support bounded simulated task capability for this candidate and search configuration, not independent task acceptance or hardware performance. Failure would motivate control-search revision or a structure-focused hypothesis while preserving unresolved search quality.
input.stopping_condition: Stop this analysis after one admitted mathematical evaluation or at the method callback/iteration limits, numerical failure, or budget exhaustion; do not infer global optimality or physical performance.
input.weakening_observation: No valid rollout is found within the bounded search, or the best valid rollout exceeds any threshold; this weakens only bounded model capability and does not establish infeasibility.

original_plan.expected_observation: The admitted nonlinear capability analysis returns a valid optimized rollout with terminal_error_m at most 0.01 m, holding_max_error_m at most 0.01 m, and holding_max_speed_m_s at most 0.03 m/s, together with explicit search-quality diagnostics.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Keep candidate identity, frozen task target and evaluator, 0.6 s duration, 0.02 s control period, model configuration, and structure parameters fixed. Optimize only the legal control source using local_control_search_v2, no more than four knots, no more than three iterations, and no more than 24 callbacks; use a final correction window consistent with the 0.06 s holding window.
original_plan.hypothesis: For the frozen reach-and-hold task, bounded nonlinear control optimization of the owned Operator-generated structure can find a four-knot control schedule whose simulated terminal error, final-window maximum position error, and final-window maximum tip speed satisfy the task thresholds.
original_plan.interpretation: A threshold-satisfying valid model rollout would support bounded simulated task capability for this candidate and search configuration, not independent task acceptance or hardware performance. Failure would motivate control-search revision or a structure-focused hypothesis while preserving unresolved search quality.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Stop this analysis after one admitted mathematical evaluation or at the method callback/iteration limits, numerical failure, or budget exhaustion; do not infer global optimality or physical performance.
original_plan.weakening_observation: No valid rollout is found within the bounded search, or the best valid rollout exceeds any threshold; this weakens only bounded model capability and does not establish infeasibility.

agent_hypothesis.hypothesis: For the frozen Operator-generated structure, bounded nonlinear control optimization with four knots and a terminal correction window can find an input schedule whose modeled terminal tip error is substantially below the unoptimized baseline while also reducing final-window speed; this is a finite-search capability hypothesis, not a claim of task acceptance or global optimality.

selected_variables: control_optimization knot inputs over the 0.6 s horizon

agent_hypothesis.expected_observation: The returned finite MuJoCo search reports a valid best schedule and modeled rollout with lower objective and terminal error than its starting source, with terminal_error_m trending toward 0.01 m and holding_max_speed_m_s trending toward 0.03 m/s.
agent_hypothesis.weakening_observation: No valid schedule is produced, numerical failure occurs, or the best finite-search rollout fails to improve terminal error and final-window speed over its starting source.
agent_hypothesis.interpretation: Improvement would support only local modeled control capability for this exact candidate and search budget. Failure would indicate weakness of this source/search configuration, not structural infeasibility.
agent_hypothesis.fixed_conditions: Keep candidate artifact, frozen reach target [0.295, 0, 0.215] m, 0.6 s duration, 0.02 s control period, model configuration, geometry, routing, topology, and evaluator fixed. Optimize only the bounded control schedule using local_control_search_v2, four knots at [0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6] s, and a 0.06 s correction window; at most 24 callbacks and 3 iterations.
agent_hypothesis.stopping_condition: Stop this analysis after one admitted finite nonlinear capability result, or earlier on numerical or admission failure; do not infer physical performance, infeasibility, or a global optimum.
